description_en: Enables a component for a workspace. This operation corresponds to enabling the collaboration component in the console. After the component is enabled, you can query the component status and current configurations
description_zh: 为工作空间开通组件，对应控制台的协作组件开通操作；开通后可查询组件状态和当前配置
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore install-workspace-plugin --workspace-id ws-123456 --plugin-name collaboration --region cn-hangzhou
name: InstallWorkspacePlugin

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the workspace component. The value collaboration corresponds to the collaboration component in the console. For other component identifiers, use the original values defined in the API parameter enumeration
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间组件标识。collaboration 对应控制台的协作组件；其他组件标识保持 API 参数枚举中的原值
parameters.name: plugin_name

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable Internet access. If this parameter is set to true and no VPC is specified, PUB_NET is used. If this parameter is set to true and a VPC is specified, PRIVATE_PUBNET is used. If only a VPC is specified, PRIVATE_NET is used. You must configure at least one of Internet access and VPC access
fields.help_zh: 设置为 true 且未指定 VPC 时使用 PUB_NET；设置为 true 且指定 VPC 时使用 PRIVATE_PUBNET；仅指定 VPC 时使用 PRIVATE_NET。公网和 VPC 至少配置一种
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the collaboration component is allowed to access the public network. This configuration only controls the public network access capability and does not expose the component service to the public network
fields.help_zh: 控制协作组件是否允许访问公网。该配置只控制公网访问能力，不表示将组件服务暴露到公网
fields.name: internet

fields.help_en: Explicitly controls whether the collaboration component uses a VPC network. If this parameter is set to false, vpcId and vSwitchIds are ignored. If this parameter is set to true, you must provide a vpcId and at least two vSwitchIds
fields.help_zh: 显式控制 collaboration 组件是否使用 VPC 网络。设置为 false 时，vpcId 和 vSwitchIds 将被忽略；设置为 true 时必须同时提供 vpcId 和至少两个 vSwitchIds
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs. The collaboration component requires that the vSwitches cover at least two different zones, and all vSwitches must belong to the VPC specified by vpcId
fields.help_zh: 交换机 ID 列表。collaboration 组件要求交换机至少覆盖两个不同可用区，且所有交换机必须属于 vpcId 指定的 VPC
fields.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en: The ID of the user VPC
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en: The user VPC and the list of vSwitches used to deploy the collaboration component. The zones corresponding to the vSwitches are queried by the server. You do not need to pass the Zones parameter
fields.help_zh: 协作组件部署使用的用户 VPC 和交换机列表。交换机对应的可用区由服务端查询，不需要用户传入 Zones
fields.name: vpc

fields.help_en: The network configuration used by the collaboration component. If not specified, the server uses the existing network configuration of the workspace
fields.help_zh: collaboration 组件使用的网络配置。未指定时，服务端使用工作空间已有的网络配置
fields.name: network

fields.help_en: The component-specific configuration. The configuration structure is determined by the pluginName parameter. Currently, the collaboration component supports the network configuration
fields.help_zh: 组件专属配置。配置结构由 pluginName 决定。当前 collaboration 组件支持 network
fields.name: config

parameters.help_en: The request body for installing the component
parameters.name: body

schema.description_zh: 安装工作空间组件响应

data.description_en: The details of the component installation operation

enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the component is enabled

status.description_en: The component status. Valid values: DISABLED, ENABLING, ENABLED, ENABLE_FAILED, DISABLING, and DISABLE_FAILED
status.title_en: 插件状态。DISABLED 表示未安装，ENABLING 表示安装中，ENABLED 表示安装完成，ENABLE_FAILED 表示安装失败。
status.title_zh: 插件状态。DISABLED 表示未安装，ENABLING 表示安装中，ENABLED 表示安装完成，ENABLE_FAILED 表示安装失败。

message.description_en: The response message. An error description is returned if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息。请求失败时返回错误描述

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

schema.title_en: 安装工作空间插件响应
schema.title_zh: 安装工作空间插件响应
